verdict.rationale: Built-in AI assistants are not normally a GPU capability, but the evidence shows NVIDIA ships Project G-Assist, an AI assistant powered by the RTX PC that can 'tune, control, and optimize your system'. That makes the axis applicable and shows some task delegation. However, it is a 'Project' (likely experimental) companion tool scoped to system tuning, and it is backed only by a single repeated marketing line. Missing for 10: details on what tasks can be delegated and how, evidence that it is a stable shipped feature rather than an experimental project, its scope beyond system tuning, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
